title: Synthetic Dataset Split Three Ways
description: Build a fine-tuning dataset with training facts, unanswerable questions, and held-out test cases including changed facts to test generalization.

steps.question: What is the purpose of grouping facts as pairs with paraphrases?
steps.answer: So a paraphrase never lands on the other side of the split

steps.description: Reveal test set: answerable, unanswerable, and changed fact questions held out from training.
